scoring_justification: Checker independently recomputes sigma from hidden inputs and formulas; numeric comparison per row plus ordering check.

outputs.description: Computed specific interfacial energy σ (J/m²) for each alloy at each temperature. The hidden checker recomputes these values and verifies that σ for 25Cr-20Ni-Nb-N is higher than σ for 22Cr-25Ni-Mo-Nb-N at both temperatures.

output_contract.notes: The lattice constants for austenite and M23C6 in both alloys are provided in the instruction as numeric inputs. The calculation does not require any external dataset.

hidden_assets.purpose: Hidden inputs for recomputation: lattice constants, elastic modulus formula, Poisson ratio, thermal expansion. All values directly from the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text; lattice constants from Fig.4 and Fig.5b; Eq.(1)-(3).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from paper's equations and reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are exactly the paper's reported measurements; they are the correct gold for recomputation.
